title: TSL: Social Conflict
description: Social scenes for D&D 5e and Level Up (a5e): twelve techniques — open them up, ask, read them, or go all in with blackmail, seduction or a lie — through Pressure, Heart or Reason. Every NPC has a hidden psychological nature that decides how each one lands: the approach that opens them, the one they close against, the price they name, the emotion they leave on you when you miss. Five emotions from Thirsty Sword Lesbians on everyone, scars that stay, Strings and bonds that carry into the campaign. Inspired by Thirsty Sword Lesbians (Powered by Lesbians).
